capabilities: Create up to 8 docks positioned on workspace edges or corners
Add shortcuts to notes, Bases, canvases, and vault files
Configure auto-hide, reveal timing, trigger areas, and magnification
Show or hide docks by note name, path, folder, or tag
Reorder dock items with drag-and-drop or keyboard controls
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or newer; detailed documentation lives in an external wiki rather than the README; includes an unresearched-plugin notice from Obsidian staff; accepts donations.
motivation: The support section implies the goal of making navigation through the workspace faster and more comfortable.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in persistent edge dock, so frequently used notes and files require repeated navigation through the sidebar or switcher.
summary: Configurable navigation docks placed at workspace edges or corners, holding shortcuts to notes, Bases, canvases, and other vault files.
